record.paper_title: Localized Spot Patterns on the Sphere for Reaction-Diffusion Systems: Theory and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Fekete point sets and large-basin equilibria
record.original_question: For the full Brusselator slow spot-dynamics DAE on the unit sphere, in which N spot locations and source strengths are coupled through the logarithmic Green-interaction matrix G_ij = log|x_i - x_j| and the nonlinear strength constraint [I - nu(I - E_0)G]S + nu(I - E_0)chi(S) - (2E/N)e = 0, what computational relationship, if any, exists for N >= 10 between equilibria that have large basins of attraction and elliptic Fekete point sets, meaning global minimizers on the unit sphere of the discrete logarithmic energy V = -sum_{i != j} log|x_i - x_j| with |x_j| = 1?

artifact.category_tag: Reaction-diffusion spot dynamics on the sphere
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^2 = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^3 : |x| = 1\}$ and let $N \geq 10$ distinct points $x_1, \dots, x_N \in \mathbb{S}^2$ represent the centers of localized spots in a Brusselator reaction-diffusion system. Let $G$ be the $N 	imes N$ symmetric matrix with entries
$$G_{ij} = \log|x_i - x_j| \quad (i 
eq j), \qquad G_{ii} = 0,$$
let $E_0 = 	frac{1}{N} e e^	op$ where $e = (1,\dots,1)^	op \in \mathbb{R}^N$, let $I$ be the $N 	imes N$ identity, and let $
u > 0$, $E > 0$ be fixed parameters. Let $S = (S_1, \dots, S_N)^	op$ denote the vector of spot source strengths and let $\chi : \mathbb{R}^N 	o \mathbb{R}^N$ be the (componentwise) nonlinearity arising from the local core problem for the Brusselator. The quasi-steady spot configurations are the solutions $(x_1, \dots, x_N; S)$ on $\mathbb{S}^2 	imes \cdots 	imes \mathbb{S}^2 	imes \mathbb{R}^N$ of the nonlinear algebraic constraint
$$ igl[I - 
u(I - E_0)G igr] S \;+\; 
u(I - E_0)\,\chi(S) \;-\;  rac{2E}{N}\, e \;=\; 0,$$
together with the equilibrium condition for the associated slow spot-dynamics differential-algebraic system on $\mathbb{S}^2$ (i.e., zero tangential gradient of the discrete interaction Hamiltonian induced by $G$ and $S$).

An elliptic Fekete point set of size $N$ on $\mathbb{S}^2$ is a global minimizer over $(\mathbb{S}^2)^N$ of the discrete logarithmic energy
$$V(x_1,\dots,x_N) \;=\; -\sum_{i 
eq j} \log|x_i - x_j|.$$

Problem. For each $N \geq 10$, determine the relationship between equilibrium configurations of the above DAE that possess large basins of attraction (under the slow spot-dynamics flow) and elliptic Fekete point sets on $\mathbb{S}^2$. In particular, decide whether (and in what asymptotic or parametric regime of $
u$ and $E$) the spatial components $(x_1,\dots,x_N)$ of large-basin equilibria coincide with, or converge to, global minimizers of $V$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a computational open problem about the relationship between large-basin equilibria of the Brusselator slow spot-dynamics DAE on the sphere and elliptic Fekete point sets. No published resolution was located; related work on spot patterns on the sphere and on optimal logarithmic energy point configurations exists but does not establish the requested correspondence for general $N \geq 10$.
